spec.name: Frostline Station 9
spec.description: A Firewatch-style arctic research outpost diorama: a red-roofed timber cabin with glowing windows on a snow-cut platform, a tall guyed radio mast with a lit beacon, a storage shed, and scattered crates, barrels, a sled and a snowmobile, all flat-coloured with bold warm-and-cold contrasts.
spec.layout: The diorama reads as a warm island in a cold field. A snow platform covers the whole footprint with sculpted drifts, a darker packed-snow path running front (+Z) to back, and exposed rock chunks at the edges; a plank deck is raised on the platform at its centre-left. The main cabin (centre-left, roughly x -1.2..0.6, z -0.8..0.9) stands on the deck: dark timber walls, a steep Firewatch orange-red gabled roof, yellow trim boards, a teal door, a stone chimney with a pale smoke wisp of cards, and warm glowing windows set in dark frames. A tall lattice radio mast rises at the right rear (x ~1.35, z ~-1.7) to y 4.6: steel-dark legs, a radar dish aimed up-forward, cross-braces, guy ropes and a red glowing beacon at the tip. Left rear sits a small timber storage shed (x -1.6..-0.7, z -2.2..-1.1) with the same roof colour and a tilted weather-vane pole. The front strip (z 0.7..2.5) holds the props: a wood sled with steel runners, a stack of crates, a ring of red fuel drums, a compact snowmobile in teal with steel skis, and a row of fence posts with a windsock on a pole at the far front-right. Style: every surface one flat colour, chunky readable silhouettes, warm oranges and yellows on cabin, roof, door glow and drums against cool blue-white snow and grey-blue steel, small parts (trim, bands, frames, flags) as their own flat-coloured pieces seated on the surfaces.

parts.builds: The snow platform the whole station stands on: a big low chunky snow slab (rounded box/loft silhouette) from x -1.9..1.9, z -2.8..2.6, top y ~0.35-0.5, standing on y=0. Cut a darker packed-snow path strip running front to back across it (snowShade) and a few iceDeep patches. Sculpt 6-8 snow drifts (squashed spheres/cones in snow and snowShade) pressed against where cabin, shed and mast bases sit. Scatter 4-5 low rock chunks (rock colour, angular boxes/prisms half-sunk) along the left, right and back edges. Build the raised plank deck at the deckTop mount: a plank (plank colour) platform ~1.9 x 1.1 with visible edge boards (timberLight), short timber stilt legs down into the snow, and 3-4 plank steps at the front edge down the drift. Also lay 2-3 flat stepping stones (rock) on the path toward the shed and mast. Keep the platform simpler than the buildings: broad shapes, no fine noise.
parts.attaches: Owns the ground line; deckTop mount is the exact deck surface where the cabin sits; snowPadRight and snowPadLeft are the flattened snow pads under the mast base and shed; drifts rise toward the other parts' boxes but stay below their boxes' floors.

parts.builds: The hero cabin on the deckTop mount, centred around x -0.3, z 0.05: a timber body (timber walls, horizontal plank boards suggested by 3-4 thin timberLight board strips as parts on each long wall) roughly 1.7 wide x 1.1 deep, from y 0.55 to y 1.95, with a steep gabled roof (roof colour) peaked at y 2.6, roofTrim fascia boards along the eaves, and a yellow trimYellow corner trim and door frame. Front faces +Z: a teal doorTeal door with a frameDark frame and trimYellow lintel, one big glowing windowGlow window left of the door and a smaller one right, both in frameDark frames with 2-3 muntin bars, plus a trimYellow-framed small gable window under the peak. A rock-coloured stone chimney climbs the right wall to y 2.9 with a frameDark cap and a smoke wisp: 4-6 smokePale cards drifting up and back on their own frames. Add a small porch: two timber posts, a plank awning strip of roof under the main roof line, and a glowing porch lamp (windowGlow dome on a steelDark bracket) beside the door. Signature detail: a trimYellow station sign board on the wall above the door with 3-4 small frameDark notches as painted lettering blocks, and a rope-and-post boot scraper by the steps.
parts.attaches: Rests exactly on the deckTop mount (floor at y 0.55); porch posts land on the deck; chimney and roof peak stay inside this box; nothing hangs below the deck.

parts.builds: A tall guyed radio mast at the snowPadRight mount (x ~1.35, z ~-1.7): three tapering steelDark leg rods converging from a triangular ~0.5 m base at y 0.4 to a single pole reaching y 4.5, with 5-6 horizontal steel cross-brace rings and X-braces (thin steel rods) up the height, and small steelDark platform collars. At the top: a dish (dish colour, a lathe or squashed-cone bowl ~0.45 across) on a short steel boom, tilted aiming up-forward (+Z, ~35 deg elevation) on the pole's front side at y ~3.4, with a feed horn rod in its centre. The tip carries a beaconRed glowing beacon dome (y ~4.5) and two thin steel whip antennas angled out. Three guy ropes (thin rope-colour rods) run from y ~3.8 down to three snow-anchored blocks (rock chunks on the snowPadRight pad). Halfway up add a small timberLight equipment box and a short crossarm with two tiny windowGlow lamp pods. Signature: a trimYellow and flagRed striped hazard band wrapped at the mast base and a small directional arrow vane (frameDark) under the dish.
parts.attaches: Base feet sit on the snowPadRight mount; guy-rope anchors land on the snow surface inside this box; the mast tip is the model's highest point.

parts.builds: The small storage shed on the snowPadLeft mount (centred x ~-1.15, z ~-1.65): a timber shed ~0.9 x 0.7 footprint, walls y 0.45..1.35 (timber with one timberLight board strip), a single-slope roof of roof colour with roofTrim edge, doorTeal double doors with frameDark frames and trimYellow hinges, a small glowing windowGlow porthole high on the side wall in a frameDark ring, and a short steel chimney stub. In front of the shed: a row of three upright tool handles/skis leaning against the wall (timberLight and steel), a barrel with a snow cap (barrel body, snow top) beside the door, and a dim trimYellow lantern hanging from the eave on a rope hook (glow). Beside the shed, a weather station: a timberLight pole to y 2.0 with a small white-lattice radiation shield box (snow colour), a rotating-cup anemometer of steel cross-arms and cups at the top, and a small flagRed pennant flag card on a short arm. Also build the far front-right windsock here: a steelDark pole at x ~1.5, z ~2.2 to y 1.7, with a horizontal steel arm and a snowShade-and-flagRed striped cone sock of cards or a swept cone pointing back (toward -Z, blowing inland), plus 4-5 fence posts (timber, frameDark caps) with two rope lines running along the front path between them.
parts.attaches: Shed floor rests on the snowPadLeft mount; weather pole and windsock poles and fence posts plant into the snow; flag and sock cards attach at their pole tips; all stays inside this box.

parts.builds: The working clutter of the station across the front strip (z 0.7..2.6) on the snow: a wood sled (crate-coloured runners and deck slats with crateLid rails, steel runner blades, a coiled rope rope-colour on top) lying flat near the path at x ~-0.6, z ~1.6; a stack of three crates (crate with crateLid lids and frameDark edge battens, one tilted, one with a trimYellow stencil bar) beside the cabin steps at x ~0.6, z ~1.0; a cluster of four fuel drums (barrel colour with two barrelBand rings each, one drum steelDark, one with a snow cap) standing in a loose ring at x ~1.3, z ~0.9; a compact snowmobile parked angled at x ~-1.0, z ~1.3 facing front-left: doorTeal body shell with trimYellow accent stripe, frameDark seat and windshield, steel skis and a small flagRed pennant on its rear rack; a pair of scattered snow-shoveled crates and a snow-covered plank; and 4-5 small details: a shovel (timberLight handle, steel blade) stuck in a drift, a steel bucket, a small stack of cut firewood (timber cylinders) by the shed path, and 3-4 tiny snow-topped crates half-buried near the back. Where snow sits on top of props, add snow-caps (snow colour flattened spheres/boxes) so everything reads as weathered in place.
parts.attaches: Everything rests on the snow surface of snowBase (tops of drifts vary; sink prop bottoms slightly into the snow); the sled and snowmobile flank the packed path; the crate stack leans against the cabin's front steps.

calls.reasoning:
Let me design an arctic research outpost diorama in Firewatch flat-colour style. Firewatch: warm oranges/reds against cool landscape, flat colours, strong silhouette, bold shapes. Arctic outpost: main cabin on stilts, radio mast with blinking light, radar dish, sled/dog kennels, snow drifts, crates, fuel drums, wind sock, antenna, glowing windows (glow kit), aurora maybe? Keep it grounded: snow base platform, main hut, tower/mast, radar dish, props (crates, barrels, sled, flags).

Plan: 4-5 builders.
1. snowBase — snow platform, ice drifts, footpath, wooden deck/stilts foundation. floor: true.
2. mainCabin — the hut: A-frame or cabin with pitched roof, warm glowing windows, door, chimney with smoke? Smoke maybe cards. Roof, walls, trim, porch light.
3. mast — radio tower with antenna, dish, guy wires, blinking red beacon (glow).
4. props — crates, fuel barrels, sled, dog... maybe a weather station, snowmobile, flags.
5. aux — smaller outbuilding (storage shed), windsock pole, fence posts, string lights between buildings.

Size: width ~3.5, height ~4.5 (mast tall), depth ~5. Overall: [3.6, 4.6, 5.2].

Palette (max 24): snow white, snow shadow (pale blue), ice blue, wood dark (hull), wood mid, wood light, roof red-orange (Firewatch signature!), trim yellow, door teal, window warm glow, window frame dark, metal steel, metal dark, rust red, beacon red glow, antenna steel, rope, smoke white... let's list ~20.

Firewatch palette: deep teal-navy sky, warm orange. Buildings: red-orange roof, dark timber, yellow trim, glowing windows.

Mounts: snowTop (y=0.35 at cabin footprint), deckY, cabin base, mast base.

Layout: front +Z: snowmobile/sled near front, cabin centre-left slightly back, mast at right rear, shed at left, crates/barrels cluster right front.
